description: Panic by Future Crew, second in the PC demo competition at The Party 1992, running from its original files in your browser.
about: Panic is Future Crew's demo for MS-DOS, shown at The Party 1992 in Aars, Denmark, and released on 4 February 1993, once it had been debugged.
credits: Code by Wildfire, with the music player and fractals by Psi and the greetings scroller by Trug. Music by Purple Motion, graphics by Pixel, 3D objects by Abyss.
released: The Party 1992: second in the PC demo competition. Released on 4 February 1993.
terms: Freeware: “you can spread and copy this as much as you want ... but only in its complete original condition.” (PANIC.NFO)
accuracy: It runs on a plain VGA (DOSBox's vgaonly), which draws its scroller and plasma as a real VGA does, line by line. Reds and blues then have half the shades.
Its fractal part runs two and a half to three times faster than on real machines.
Mono, where the original pans its music hard left and right.
